thread:
Partner PM: quick heads-up — Matrix Systems SI hit a blocker on their on-prem private deployment, go-live planned for tomorrow. runtime error: "cudaContextCreate failed: driver version mismatch". Stack: Redwood Private v1.9.2, NVIDIA A30, Ubuntu 22.04. Tagging @Devon @Li for immediate help

Devon: thanks — can you paste the exact runtime logs and what nvidia-smi shows? my guess is driver vs runtime CUDA lib mismatch, or kernel module not loaded. @deploy-bot can you surface the last private deploy metadata for matrix?

Partner PM: paste of the log snippet from the agent: ```
2025-07-10T14:12:03Z ERROR inference.runtime: failed to init cuda backend: cudaErrorUnknown: cudaContextCreate failed: unknown error (driver version mismatch)
2025-07-10T14:12:03Z INFO retrying with fallback
```
And they reported: nvidia-smi -> "Driver Version: 525.89.02". runtime image is redwood/runtime:1.9.2 which was built against cuda 11.4 libs.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: private-deploy/matrix-2025-07-10 completed. image=redwood/runtime:1.9.2, kernel=5.15.0-70-generic, kube-node-labels=[gpu=true, vendor=matrix-rack].

Li: that lines up — runtime built against cuda 11.4 expects driver ~470. If the host driver is 525 there's a compatibility gap. Two paths: (1) install matching legacy driver (470) on host, or (2) use a runtime image with cuda runtime libs matching 525. Do you have control over host drivers? ask them to run `modinfo nvidia` and `lsmod | grep nvidia` and paste output. also inside container run `ldd /opt/redwood/runtime/lib/libcudart.so | grep cuda` to check which libcudart version is present.

Carlos - Matrix: we tried apt install nvidia-driver-470 but `modprobe nvidia` fails: "module nvidia not found for kernel 5.15.0-70-generic". Kernel is custom from our vendor and we cannot rebuild overnight. We can try the other option (runtime image).

Priya: for SI delivery support, we can fast-track a compatibility image. Ops options: (A) provide redwood/runtime:1.9-cuda11.8 (prebuild) to match 525-series drivers, or (B) provide a sidecar that injects libcuda compatibility shim. I'll coordinate with eng to produce a patched image. In the meantime, is there a low-risk fallback so they don't block tomorrow's canary? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Devon: temp mitigation: enable CPU fallback for non-critical routes — set env `REDWOOD_CPU_FALLBACK=true` and route canary traffic to a CPU-only pool. Latency will increase but keeps the app up. Example k8s patch (apply to the canary Deployment):
```yaml
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: inference
        env:
        - name: REDWOOD_CPU_FALLBACK
          value: "true"
```
I'll also start building a redwood/runtime:1.9.2-cuda11.8 image (estimated 45m) and upload to private registry.

Samir: looping in customer success and Matrix SI lead to coordinate communication. Matrix agreed to the CPU fallback for the first canary so we don't miss the submit-to-production window. Carlos, can you confirm once the fallback patch is applied?

Carlos - Matrix: applied the patch, can confirm canary pods restarted with `REDWOOD_CPU_FALLBACK=true`. Inference still works, throughput down ~6x but acceptable for canary traffic. We'll schedule driver/kernel work with our vendor tomorrow 08:00 local and attempt the 525-compatible runtime image next.

Priya: thanks — I will open a formal SI escalation ticket and a short runbook for future marketplace listings: "on-prem driver compatibility checklist" (will include kernel/modinfo, driver version, recommended runtime tags). I'll also set a 10:00am PST postmortem with Matrix and the SI.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2025-2197 created for Matrix on-prem driver compatibility. Priority: P2. Assigned: eng-platform, partnerships, customer-success.

Devon: tracking — once the cuda11.8 image is pushed I'll post the image tag here and mark the ticket as blocked->in-progress. Good catch by the SI team for surfacing the driver mismatch early. :thumbsup:

Partner PM: great teamwork, thanks everyone. I'll update Matrix stakeholders and confirm go/no-go after the morning remediation.
